description: Named by Central's trust tier label (Growth). What a team on it may do: live keys, monthly spend across its keys' caps, and the rate limits its keys run under when they carry none of their own. Central names a team's tier and renames it when the label changes; the values here are Grove's to edit.

fields.description: What a team's live keys may spend in a month together: Σ the keys' caps stays within it. 0 lets no cap be set. Lowering it stops no key; it only refuses a raise or a new cap until the caps fit again.
fields.label: Spend Limit (USD / month)

fields.description: Counted on the gateway per team and model, per Gateway Store, however many keys the team holds; a window resets on the UTC clock. One row per model, metric and window: a blank model is every model, a named one stands in for it there. No rows: the tier's teams are uncapped. The rows are the catalog's — catalog.json rewrites them on every migrate — and reach every key of every team on the tier at the next sync.
fields.label: Limits

name: Tier
